preconditions.description: Victim (token holder) must have a non-zero balance of BGLG tokens
Victim must have approved the attacker's address with allowance equal to uint256 max value (~uint256(0) = 2^256-1)
Contract must not be paused (paused == false)
Attacker must not be blacklisted (tokenBlacklist[attacker] == false)

exploit_hint: If a victim has approved your address with the maximum uint256 allowance (~uint256(0)), you can call transferFrom repeatedly to drain their entire token balance without the allowance being decremented. The check 'if (allowance[_from][msg.sender] < ~uint256(0))' will be false for max allowance, skipping the deduction. Call transferFrom(victim, attacker, victimBalance) multiple times to steal all tokens.
